title: My Soul Longs for the Lord
input: My Soul Longs for the Lord

candidates.title: My Soul Longs for the Lord - Lyric Video

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: My soul longs for the Lord
In a weary land
Wells are dry, and I am empty
Only dust in my hands

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: How I yearn for streams of mercy
Where my soul can be restored
Come and drink, Jesus calls me,
And you will thirst no more

lyrics.label: Refrain
lines: Oh, the fullness of Christ
Word of God, Word of Life

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Living Word, You walked among us
Our Emmanuel
And You spoke into the darkness
Broke the powers of hell

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Grace and mercy flowed from Calv'ry
To the valley of our need
It is done, It is finished!
From every sin set free

lyrics.label: Refrain
lines: Oh, the victory of Christ
Word of God, Word of Life

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lines: How often in the stillness
Have I heard Your voice
Every whisper every promise
Calls my heart to rejoice

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lines: In the quiet of the morning
Through the watches of the night
In the fire of my struggles
There's courage for the fight
Oh, the power of Christ
Word of God, Word of Life

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lines: My soul longs to walk closer
With the Lord I serve
More than riches, more than favor
I delight in Your Word

lyrics.label: Verse 8
lines: Turn my gaze from all that's worthless
Set my heart on things above
May my life tell Your goodness
Your way of truth and love

lyrics.label: Refrain
lines: Oh, the wisdom of Christ
Word of God, Word of Life

lyrics.label: Verse 9
lines: My soul longs for the day
I will see Your face
Hear Your shout of jubilation
No more tears, death or pain!

lyrics.label: Bridge
lines: Every word at last accomplished
Heaven sings and earth replies
To our God be the glory!
Let all creation cry

lyrics.label: Refrain
lines: Praise and honor to Christ
Word of God, Word of Life

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: To our God be the glory
